_comment: Sensitivity gate for the Financial Crime AI Lab. Enforced by the frugal plugin's guard_sensitive.py PreToolUse hook: an Agent (sub-agent) spawn whose text matches a rule is blocked unless the target agent is in allow_agents, so the work stays in the main loop. Fails CLOSED: a malformed file blocks all delegation. Tested by tests/test_sensitivity_gate.py - add a positive and a negative case there for every rule you change. Patterns are Python regexes; paths are fnmatch globs (* also matches /).

rules.name: iban
rules._comment: Any IBAN shape (2-letter country, 2 check digits, 11-30 alphanumerics), with or without 4-char spacing.

rules.name: uk-sort-code-and-account
rules._comment: Sort code (12-34-56 or 12 34 56) followed within ~30 chars by an 8-digit account number. A sort code on its own is not flagged (too date-like).

rules.name: payment-card-pan
rules._comment: Visa / Mastercard / Amex / Discover number shapes, optional space or dash separators.

rules.name: uk-national-insurance-number
rules._comment: HMRC NINO format, excluding invalid prefixes (D, F, I, Q, U, V; O as second letter).

rules.name: passport-number-in-context
rules._comment: 9-digit or 2-letter+7-digit number within 25 chars of the word passport. Bare 9-digit numbers are too common to flag.

rules.name: case-and-sar-material
rules._comment: Real case material: SAR / DAML references with an identifier, protective markings, and the lab's restricted folders. Talking ABOUT SARs or typologies is fine; carrying a reference number is not. Path globs are prefixed with * so ./ and backtick-quoted paths still match.

rules.name: secrets-and-keys
rules._comment: API keys, tokens and private key material, by content or by path.
